summary: TrustCo Bank Corp NY filed a Form 8-K on October 13, 2026, solely to announce its third quarter 2026 earnings release and call schedule. The $6.5 billion savings and loan holding company, operating 133 branches through Trustco Bank across New York, New Jersey, Vermont, Massachusetts, and Florida, will report results after market close on October 21, 2026, with a conference call at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time on October 22, 2026. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are present. This is a routine earnings-timing current report, offering no special-situations or risk-arb angle.
